acceptance_criteria: AC-01: project schema version 2 can select SQLite or GitHub Issues without provider runtime configuration or credentials.
AC-02: core retains provider-neutral TaskSource and TaskSink contracts and adds a read-only environment dependency checker.
AC-03: SQLite bootstrap, provider clients, authentication, initialization, and mirror processes are absent from core.
AC-04: eng-project-governance checks an injected dependency before adapter access and never bootstraps the environment.
AC-05: documentation explains Session activation, system-of-record ownership, mirror ownership, and the version-1 migration.
AC-06: focused tests and Skill validation pass while the public registry remains exactly five Skills.
AC-07: the local candidate is pushed only to the named contributor branch and opened as a GitHub pull request.

goal-r1.summary: Move provider construction out of skill-creator while keeping a provider-neutral project binding, SDK contract, and dependency check.

architecture-r2.summary: Project configuration selects an adapter and opaque runtime profile; the environment resolves and injects the already-created provider dependency.
decisions: Keep the TaskSource and TaskSink SDK contract in core.
Replace SQLite-specific project fields with adapter identity, binding, profile reference, contract version, and required capabilities.
Delete the concrete SQLite runtime and provider lifecycle tests from core.
Add one read-only checker instead of a registry, factory, bootstrapper, or provider loader.
Keep system-of-record and mirror-direction decisions in project governance while leaving mirror operation to the environment.
Use a breaking schema version without compatibility aliases or shims.

closure_decision.loop: project selects adapter -> environment injects matching dependency -> checker validates -> Skill uses generic SDK -> missing capability produces an actionable stop
closure_decision.success_signal: SQLite and GitHub selections validate through the same schema and checker tests pass without any provider runtime in core
defer_until: a provider registry until more than one runtime integration needs shared discovery
provider conformance suites until runtime packages are added outside this core
reject: provider bootstrap in a governance Skill
credentials or client settings in project.yaml
a SQLite compatibility layer in core
closure_decision.replacement_seam: AdapterDependency and the TaskSource/TaskSink protocols are the injection seam.

gate_evidence.skill-structure-validation: repository-validator-pass; bundled quick validator unavailable because PyYAML is not installed

impact_record.reason: Record the exact local implementation candidate and validation evidence before authorized remote review.

remote_sync_decision.reason: The user explicitly requested a GitHub merge request after the redesign is complete.
